title: Curved-interface convergence on the G3-04 dielectric cylinder: mesh sequence with staircase and subpixel interfaces, sub-cell centre shifts and the differentiable-solid smoothing width

fixture.base: the G3-04 cylinder fixture (2D, radius 0.3 um, n = 1.5, domain 3.2 um, PML 0.4 um, TFSF box 1.6 um, monitors at 1.1 um, 1.3 to 1.8 um in nine samples, 120 fs), TM (Ez) and TE (Ey), CPU FP64
fixture.a_staircase: scattering width error against Mie at h, h/2, h/4 with the staircase interface
fixture.c_shift: cylinder centre shifted along x by 0, h/4 and h/2 at the fixed mesh above, staircase and subpixel; the TFSF box and monitors stay fixed, so any change of the width is grid-registration error
fixture.d_smoothing: DifferentiableSolid.cylinder rasterised by smooth_geometry_epsilon at the Yee positions with transition width w = fraction x h, injected into the standard TFSF solver through the voxelize hook of torchfdtd.solver (test-side override, same solver, same source and monitors); off the contour the vanishing width reproduces the staircase image exactly, while samples lying on the contour to 1e-9 um (four Ez nodes at h = 0.05 um for the 0.3 um radius) take the documented half value, so the vanishing-width row is a second staircase variant and its difference from row (a) is recorded
fixture.cost_metric: single-run wall seconds of Simulation.run including preparation, on a shared workstation; reported as a diagnostic only

reference_method: the infinite-cylinder Mie series of tests/test_physics_g3_b.py (see G3-04)

observables.name: max_relative_error
observables.definition: max over the nine wavelengths of |width/Mie - 1| for each row

observables.name: convergence_order_estimates
observables.definition: log2 of the ratio of successive max_relative_error values of a mesh sequence

observables.name: max_relative_error_spread
observables.definition: largest minus smallest max_relative_error over the three centre shifts

observables.name: width_variation_relative
observables.definition: largest per-wavelength spread of the width over the shifts divided by the mean width

observables.name: max_relative_difference_from_staircase
observables.definition: max over wavelengths of |width(w)/width(staircase) - 1| for a smoothing width w

acceptance.pass_fail: subpixel max_relative_error at h = 0.05 um is below the staircase max_relative_error at h = 0.05 um for the centred cylinder, for TM and for TE
acceptance.sharp_limit: the w = 1e-6 h image equals the staircase image at every sample off the contour and takes the half value on the contour; the resulting width difference from row (a) is recorded, not limited
acceptance.reported_not_judged: convergence order estimates, monotonicity, shift spreads, the smoothing-width sweep and whether the subpixel error at h is below the staircase error at h/2 at lower wall time
acceptance.source_of_limits: fixture-specific expectation declared here; no second-order or monotone criterion is imposed on staircased curved surfaces

not_yet_covered: shifts along the transverse axis and diagonal shifts
the smoothing width as a convergence parameter jointly with the mesh

notes: An exploratory run at h = 0.05 um with both interfaces and the three shifts preceded this declaration. A first draft required the vanishing-width row to match row (a) to 1e-6; the fast suite showed the documented half value on the four contour-coincident Ez nodes (a 2.7 percent TM width change at h = 0.05 um), so the check was restated as above before the recorded run. The case is added in the commit following 2b64f91.
